nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and refinance-ready — the 6.62% rate plus $41/mo PMI create a clear, tangible opportunity they've already bought into, so the only job is to remove friction and move them to application immediately.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Lead with a direct, specific reply to exactly what they asked — no preamble, no re-pitch
  - Acknowledge their current situation in one line: 6.62% conventional, $1,575/mo P&I, plus $41/mo PMI on top
  - Do not open with 'Great question!' or a generic mortgage intro

- Make the opportunity concrete using only their real numbers
  - Their all-in payment today includes $1,575 P&I + $41 PMI = $1,616/mo combined exposure
  - Tell them a refi could address both — but do NOT invent a new rate or payment; instead say you want to pull their actual numbers before quoting
  - Frame it as: 'I want to show you the real savings on your $232,268 balance before I throw out a number'

- Move straight to the soft credit pull / application — do not stack discovery questions
  - One clear call to action: 'I can run a soft pull right now — no impact to your credit — and have real numbers in front of you in minutes'
  - Offer the e-sign link or a 10-minute callback as the only two options
  - Keep the message short: one paragraph max, one ask

- Avoid re-selling or piling on questions
  - Do not ask why they want to refi, how long they plan to stay, or what their goals are — they are already moving
  - If they reply with a question, answer it directly and re-extend the single next-step ask
